checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: gauge, a zero-dependency terminal metrics ruler (spark, bars, stats) with a strict numeric parser, deterministic renderers and JSON summary output

impact_assessment.why: Logs and measurements reach the terminal as walls of numbers; a small local tool should make trend and distribution visible without installing anything or sending data anywhere.
impact_assessment.benefits: One command turns argv, stdin or a file into a sparkline, signed bars or a statistics block; JSON output composes with other tools; fixed output strings are testable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI flags and JSON keys are public interfaces; dependency: none beyond the Python 3.9 standard library; concurrency: one short-lived filter process with no shared state; state: reads stdin and files and writes nothing unless redirected.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze the interface in ADR-001 and the statistical definitions in ADR-002 before code, test every renderer against fixed strings, dogfood golden and malformed input in a temp jail, and run aikit check before the commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Core numeric parser and summary statistics: strict finite-number decoding, median, nearest-rank p90 and population stdev, with package metadata and focused unit tests
[3/4] Deterministic renderers and CLI surfaces: eight-level sparklines, signed bars with a zero axis, the stats table and JSON, demo, source validation and the Why/Fix error triad
[4/4] README, ADR-001..003, G-001, dogfood gate and codebase map are in place; checklists: passed

handoff.next: stage the explicit file list and commit as feat(gauge)

checkpoints.description: Task 'gauge-v1' completed successfully.
[1/1] Harden statistics and rendering for extreme finite values, and refuse a sum that leaves the float range

impact_assessment.why: A finite token such as 1e308 is inside the documented input contract, but the variance calculation overflowed and crashed stats; a numeric tool must handle the representable range or refuse with the triad.
impact_assessment.benefits: Statistics and charts stay finite across the float range; an unrepresentable sum fails cleanly; unit, CLI and dogfood regression steps pin both paths.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ordinary-input statistics and JSON keys must not change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Scale by the largest magnitude, halve before adding even medians, normalize renderer ratios when the raw span overflows, and run the full gate plus a new dogfood step before the commit.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Scaled statistics, overflow-safe even medians and renderer ratios, plus unit, CLI and dogfood regressions; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: add gauge hist, a deterministic equal-width histogram with a fixed bin contract and the ASCII twin

impact_assessment.why: Mean and p90 say where a series sits, but not whether it is clustered, uniform or bimodal; a histogram shows the shape without adding a plotting dependency.
impact_assessment.benefits: One more surface from the same arguments, file or pipe; equal-width bins are easy to explain and reproduce; empty bins stay visible; the zero-dependency, pipes-only contract is unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: bin edges, labels and the --bins flag become user-visible interfaces; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; extreme values can overflow naive edge arithmetic.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze the bin rules in ADR-004, compute edges by weighted interpolation, close the last bin and clamp the maximum into it, golden-test the renderer, and add unit, CLI and dogfood steps before the commit.

[1/4] Plan: add field/delimiter extraction (-f/-d), extended percentiles in stats, and horizontal box plot (gauge box)

impact_assessment.why: Enable users to parse multi-column logs/CSVs directly with -f/-d, view arbitrary quantiles in stats, and visualize 5-number distributions via a horizontal box plot without extra dependencies.
impact_assessment.benefits: Direct integration into tabular/log pipelines; flexible percentile inspection; compact visual summary of spread and skew; 100% backward-compatible text and JSON contracts.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: -f, -d, --percentiles, and box subcommand become public interfaces; JSON key additions must not alter existing keys; concurrency: none; dependency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze contracts in ADR-005, ADR-006, ADR-007; test edge cases, out-of-bounds fields, invalid delimiters, and flat series; add golden tests and dogfood chaos tests.
